android.desc:
* This app uses the Device Administrator permission.
If Android version is lower than 9.0, you should allow the permission to make the "screen lock" launcher action work.

* This app uses Accessibility service API for the following Launcher actions only if necessary:
 - Expand notifications
 - Expand quick settings
 - Open recent apps
 - Screen lock
 - Power dialog


Square Home is the ultimate launcher featuring a clean, modern tile layout. Designed for phones, tablets, TV boxes, and especially foldable devices, it offers a user experience that is simple, beautiful, and incredibly powerful.

Key Features:
* Foldable Screen Support: Perfectly adapts to foldable displays, offering a seamless experience on devices like the Galaxy Z Fold series.
* Vertical & Horizontal Scrolling: Effortlessly scroll vertically within pages and horizontally between pages.
* Smart Tile Interface: Experience a dynamic, grid-based tile UI with full tablet and large-screen support.
* Stunning Tile Effects: Customize your home screen with beautiful tile animations and visual effects, including the new Liquid Glass option that dynamically reacts to tile movement, device motion (accelerometer), and your touch.
* Live Notifications: View notifications and unread counts directly on your tiles.
* Smart App Drawer: Automatically sorts your apps based on usage patterns, putting your favorites first.
* Quick Contacts Access: Reach your important contacts instantly right from your tiles.
* Limitless Customization: Personalize every aspect of your launcher with extensive layout and styling options.

Keywords: Launcher, Tile Layout, Tile Interface, Foldable Launcher, Custom Launcher, Home Screen, Grid UI, Liquid Glass
